name: WHFRP
description: A general theme for any game system: grim fantasy after the look of the 4th-edition WFRP books, in dark grey-brown ink with grey panels with torn edges, a plum chapter tab, a green medallion, Libre Caslon Display headings and Crimson Text. An unofficial, fan-made look, not affiliated with or endorsed by the owners of the work or game it is named after.
